limitations: Relatively small sample (n=23 after exclusions), increasing Type II error risk
Participant pool was mostly male university students with comparatively high computer familiarity
Very short exposure per condition (~1-2 minutes) may have limited restorative/cognitive effects
Ceiling effects in several behavioral tasks constrained sensitivity to detect performance differences
